settings.question: Are the findings nickel-free?
settings.answer: Yes, I use nickel-safe findings. Each listing says exactly what the clasp and spacers are made from: [sterling silver, silver-plated or copper].

settings.question: Are the stones real?
settings.answer: [Yes. Each listing says which beads are natural stone, glass or clay.]

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit?
settings.answer: Send it back and I'll resize it or swap it, free. [Confirm the resize-or-swap window.]

settings.question: How long does a custom bracelet take?
settings.answer: Made-to-order pieces are ready to post in [5 to 7] working days.

settings.text:
